issues.concern: The word 'しんどい' is informal, not formal.
The English translation 'My body feels weak from a cold' misrepresents the Japanese '風邪で体がしんどい'. 'しんどい' in this context means 'my body feels heavy/tired/exhausted from a cold', not 'weak'.
issues.suggestion: My body feels exhausted/heavy from a cold.
